name: comfyui
author: NeuronScope
description: ComfyUI inside Studio: installs it in its own Python environment with the PyTorch build for your GPU, runs it, and shows it as a tab. Optionally adds ComfyUI-Manager, LLM node packs, and NeuronScope nodes (chat through Studio, hallucination checks, graphs).

tab.label: ComfyUI
tab.tip: Node-based image, video and LLM workflows (ComfyUI)

jobs.title: ComfyUI: install
jobs.help: Clone ComfyUI, make its own virtual environment, install PyTorch for this machine's GPU and ComfyUI's requirements. Run it again to repair.

fields.name: torch
fields.help: which PyTorch: auto picks from the GPUs found

fields.name: manager
fields.help: add ComfyUI-Manager (install custom nodes from ComfyUI)

fields.name: neuronscope_nodes
fields.help: add NeuronScope's nodes: chat through Studio, hallucination check, run a graph

fields.name: llm_nodes
fields.help: LLM node packs: comfyui_LLM_party, ComfyUI-LLMs-Toolkit, ComfyUI-LLMs

jobs.title: ComfyUI: run
jobs.help: Start ComfyUI; it runs until you cancel this job. The ComfyUI tab shows it.

fields.name: listen
fields.help: 0.0.0.0 to reach it from other computers (it has no login of its own)

jobs.title: ComfyUI: update
jobs.help: git pull ComfyUI and its custom nodes, then update the requirements.

jobs.title: ComfyUI: add a custom node
jobs.help: Clone a custom node repository into custom_nodes and install its requirements.
